correctness.rationale: The complete 64-term integer subset-sum polynomial gives precisely 20 double and 24 singleton eigenspaces. The five masks 15 XOR 23 XOR 30 XOR 59 XOR 61 = 0 force contradictory odd parity for any two control vertices. All six masks meet the first or second coordinate, proving PBH rank for the 3-input set {0,e1,e2}; the highest-differing-coordinate argument proves persistence for all separated higher dimensions. Independently rerun standard-library checker gives 4096 Walsh-Laplacian identities, 2016 failed pair placements, 280 checked extension collision fibers; finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: An exact actuator-resource gap on an infinite family of connected, positive-weight, vertex-transitive networks is a motivated control-design boundary, not a routine count: maximum eigenspace dimension two is insufficient for independent coordinate inputs, and an explicit three-vertex placement is proved. A short odd-parity obstruction yields a reusable local certificate. The number of inputs matters even when arbitrary input-channel designs would achieve two; the result makes no robustness or smallest-dimension claim.
